c1.evidence: REFERRER will earn a $50 cash bonus for each person referred to AmeriServ Bank who does not already have an AmeriServ Bank DDA ACCOUNT or LOAN, opens a new DDA ACCOUNT or LOAN, and completes all other requirements within the time specified for qualification in the program.

c2.evidence: Official URL on the institution's own domain.

c3.evidence: Refer-a-Friend program (referrer-side payout), not a new-customer signup bonus.

c4.evidence: No sign-up fee or purchase required for the referrer.

s1.note: Referrer must complete and submit the AmeriServ Refer-A-Friend form via the electronic form at ameriserv.com/referafriend or a printed form at a branch.

s2.note: The referred person must not already have an AmeriServ DDA account or loan; must open a new DDA account or loan; account must remain open and in good standing for a minimum of 60 days; referrer's account must remain open and in good standing until the referred person completes all requirements.

s3.note: No referral cap stated; refer as many friends as you like.

s4.note: Reward is a $50 cash bonus deposited to the referrer's AmeriServ DDA account within 30 days after the 60-day requirement is met (or a check if no DDA account). Program open to customers 18+; employees and families ineligible. Offer may be discontinued at any time.

s5.note: Estimated 5-15 minutes of active time to submit the referral form.

s6.note: Offer ongoing on the official page (checked 2026-09-23); may be discontinued at any time.

s7.note: A 1099 will be issued to any customer exceeding $600 in referral payments in one calendar year.
